The two supplied units are BASE-side text excerpts (lines 1209-2033) of docs/architecture/inference.md. The PR changes this file only in documentation: the date stamp, a GLM5Next video frame-timing paragraph (variable-frame-rate video is now indexed by nominalFrameRate rather than refused), and a new head-side paragraph near lines 876-895 and 1732-1751. I saw only a truncated patch excerpt, so the head-only additions at 876-895 and 1732-1751 were not fully visible.

No executable code, config, or security controls change in the supplied evidence, so no security regression can be shown from these units. The base excerpts cover deadline admission, MTP, sampling defaults, reasoning parsing, tool-call parsers, vision caps and MiMo load ownership. They touch T-041 and TB-007 only incidentally: the prefix-cache statements (SSD checkpoint reuse, native-precision KV, media requests excluded from prefix lookup/capture) are descriptive and consistent with the T-041 posture.

Open questions for the next pass:
1. The GLM5Next change is documented as relaxing a variable-frame-rate video refusal in the processor. The code change (GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset) is not in this batch. Reviewers should check that decoded-frame caps (512 MiB), the visual-token cap (28,532) and media memory reservations still bound VFR inputs, because the doc now says VFR tracks are accepted. This relates to the media-DoS surface and T-050-style plaintext media handling.
2. The head-side doc addition at about lines 1732-1751 (the stray-think-close absorption paragraph in the patch hunk) corresponds to code that is not visible here.

I am not raising a finding on either point, because the code is outside the supplied evidence.
